title.tr: Cam cepheli binada ahşap direkli üst balkon ve kereste korkuluk
title.en: Upper balcony on timber posts on a glass-fronted building, with timber railing

alt.tr: Cam cepheli binanın üstünde ahşap direklere oturan balkon; kereste korkuluk
alt.en: Balcony on timber posts above a glass-fronted building, with timber railing

caption.tr: Balkonun altı yatay tahta kaplı, direkler zemine iniyor. Korkuluk yeni, açık renkli tahtalardan yapılmış.
caption.en: The underside of the balcony is clad in horizontal boards and the posts run down to the ground. The railing is new, made of light boards.
